_comment: Real historical pull requests from rjmurillo repositories with known outcomes. Use them to score maintainer-review decisions offline: run the skill against each PR as it stood before its final outcome, then compare the recommendation with expected_recommendation. known_outcome records what actually happened on GitHub; expected_recommendation is the skill-level disposition consistent with that outcome. No case is invented.

cases.title: fix: exception in codefix of explicit mock behavior
cases.evidence: Small fix (+25/-5) generalizing a type check to the base syntax type, with new target-typed new test data. The owner replied that he would merge it for the next release and backport it.

review_state.note: Review only comments, commits, and CI results before cutoff_before, at head_sha against base_sha.

cases.title: Fix analyzer crash on C# 13 params collections
cases.known_outcome: closed unmerged by its author after the owner showed main already fixed the defect via #1311
cases.evidence: Owner comments: the unsafe cast was replaced on main by GetParamsElementType with regression coverage added in #1320, so the PR is effectively superseded. The author closed it as redundant.

cases.title: security: agent instructions merge unreviewed via dependabot pull_request_target pipeline
cases.known_outcome: closed unmerged by the owner; CLA not signed; no closing rationale posted
cases.evidence: The PR adds a warning paragraph to agent instruction files instead of changing the workflow it describes, so the proposed mechanism does not act on the claimed risk. The body also addresses agent instructions directly, which the skill must treat as untrusted content. The owner closed it without a comment, so the need status here is the skill's expected classification, not a quoted owner rationale.
